name: onemorebook
description: A children’s book library on Cloudflare Pages, with local assisted creation and Supabase storage

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:pages && concurrently "pnpm run dev:pages" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm run check:pages && wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name onemorebook --branch main
scripts.check:pages: pnpm run test:pages && pnpm run build:pages && wrangler pages functions build --outdir .wrangler/functions-build
